headline: Why won't he commit when neither of us has time to waste?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were hidden, but your hand found the one ready to act now.
Both hands are occupied above a table with every tool.
You asked why he will not commit when there is no time to waste. The action on this card catches me.
He has not committed, and the urgency is already inside your question.
At the point where action would become commitment, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the card held by one thing.
One rope holds one ankle. Everything else has room.
You asked why the commitment is held when time matters. This card makes me look at the one rope.
Still, the future remains held while time feels costly.
There's something between the relationship and its future. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs were identical, yet your hand went to the one in full light.
The full sun is high behind him.
You asked why he has not committed. The full light on this card is the part I notice first.
But the commitment has not moved, though the relationship has no time to waste.
What has hold of the commitment keeps it separate from the movement already happening. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the commitment…
